We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We’re looking for a doctor who has moved into AI and can code, to join Clinical AI R&D as a Clinical AI Engineer. You’ll sit inside a product pod and own the evidence for its product: define the evaluation before anyone builds, run it to a standard a journal reviewer would accept, keep watching the product once it ships, publish what the evidence shows, and change the product when the evidence says to.



The pod’s engineers can change the product but can’t judge whether a discharge summary missed something a consultant would catch. Clinicians can make that call but can’t open a pull request. You do both, and you treat the gap between a model’s output and good clinical practice as the thing you’re here to measure and close.



The loop doesn’t end at launch. You stay with the product for its life in market.

 

What you’ll do

  • Design the evaluation. Define evaluations for greenfield products to an academic standard: endpoints, comparators, ground truth, sample size, analysis plan. Set the bar before the result arrives.

  • Build the measurement. Build, optimize and validate the LLM judges and rubrics that score the product at scale. Report their agreement with clinician ground truth, not their convenience, and retire the ones that drift.

  • Run it and write it up. Execute the evaluation, do the statistics, and write it up once in a form that serves the pod, the regulatory file and an academic submission.

  • Run post-market surveillance. Monitor output quality in production and respond to regulatory feedback with data. Our clinical safety team triages complaints and incidents; you’re their counterpart in the pod, working out what their findings mean for the product and what should change.

  • Fix what the evidence finds. Prompt and rubric changes, evaluation harness changes, code changes in the pod’s codebase, shipped through the pod’s normal review and release process.

  • Publish. Contribute to peer-reviewed literature on the translational benefit of the product.

  • Be the clinician in the room. Catch the output that reads well and is wrong. Hold the line on clinical nuance when a shortcut would ship faster.

 

What you'll need

  • A medical degree and clinical practice with independent clinical judgment. This role runs on medical nuance, and this requirement doesn’t flex.

  • Academic depth. Study design, inferential statistics, agreement and reliability measures, sample size, handling of multiple comparisons. Thesis or publication-level work, not a methods module.

  • Experience evaluating medical software or clinical AI, including building or validating LLM-as-judge pipelines.

  • Enough engineering to work in a production codebase. Read it, understand what a change will do, make the change in Python or TypeScript, and get it through review. Prompt engineering and AI-assisted coding are daily tools here, and they’re the floor, not the ceiling.

  • Independence. You can run a project for weeks with light direction, and you say early when it’s stuck.

  • Clear writing. Evaluation reports, surveillance summaries and manuscripts are the primary output of this role.

Nice to have

  • Post-market surveillance or vigilance work under a medical device framework (TGA, MHRA, FDA or EU MDR). Appetite to learn counts for more than existing depth.

  • Peer-reviewed publications on clinical AI or LLM evaluation.

  • Machine learning background beyond prompting, such as fine-tuning or classical model evaluation.

  • Specialty depth in an area Heidi is moving into.

  • An academic or clinical-site network able to host a study.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Our Benefits

  • Equity from day one. When Heidi wins, you win. You'll share directly in the success you help create.

  • Your health, covered. Comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, plus 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder and a £100/month Healthy Heidi’s stipend.

  • Global parental leave. 26 weeks paid for primary carers and 18 weeks for secondary carers, subject to eligibility.

  • Fertility support. £7,000 one-off payment, eligibility applies.

  • Learning & development. £700 per year for courses, books, memberships, conferences and more.

  • Home office budget of £500 one-off to set up a workspace you actually want to work in.

  • Recharge days after major milestones and busy periods so you can reset and come back strong.

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year, wherever the world takes you.

  • Clinical leave. 10 days per year for eligible clinical roles to maintain accreditation and requirements.

  • Flexibility that works. A hybrid environment, with 3 days in the office.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

Kraken Customer

raw.title: Technical Support & Operations Engineer
raw.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About the Role

As part of the continued growth of our activities and the deployment of our photonic Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) to international customers, we are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Technician / Engineer to join our team.

You will contribute to the operational monitoring of Quandela's QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites, ensuring their proper operation and supporting maintenance activities, both remotely and on site.

Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required.

The role combines technical support, maintenance, field interventions, training and continuous improvement in a complex and international technological environment.

Internal training will provide you with the specific knowledge required to understand our technology and systems. No previous experience in quantum computing is required.

As our support and maintenance activities are still being structured, you will also contribute to improving our processes, tools and operational methods.

Your Key Responsibilities:  

System operations & technical support

You will contribute to maintaining the operational performance and availability of QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites.

    • Monitor the operation and performance of installed systems.
    • Analyse operational data and identify anomalies or performance degradation.
    • Perform initial technical investigations to characterise issues and help determine the appropriate resolution path.
    • Follow up on technical incidents and corrective actions with the relevant teams.
    • Maintain accurate technical records of systems and interventions.
    • Provide remote technical support to customers and trained personnel working on the systems.

Maintenance & customer-site interventions

You will contribute to the preparation and follow-up of preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

    • Track maintenance schedules and anticipate upcoming interventions.
    • Identify the resources, equipment, spare parts and technical expertise required for each intervention.
    • Perform diagnostic, maintenance and system recovery operations according to established procedures.
    • Support technicians and technical experts remotely or on site during interventions.
    • Perform functional checks and testing following maintenance activities.
    • Track completed actions, outstanding issues and upcoming maintenance requirements.

The role involves business travel within France and internationally, with frequency and duration depending on the needs of our installed systems.

User training & technical guidance

You will help customers and technical operators become increasingly autonomous in operating and maintaining our QPUs.

    • Train users and technical operators on routine QPU operation and maintenance activities.
    • Support users in operating the systems and their control interfaces.
    • Share best practices for operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Contribute to the creation and improvement of training materials and technical documentation.

Documentation & continuous improvement

You will ensure the traceability of technical operations and contribute to structuring our support and maintenance activities.

    • Prepare technical monitoring, intervention and maintenance reports.
    • Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for installed systems.
    • Contribute to writing and improving diagnostic, maintenance and operating procedures.
    • Capitalise on field experience to improve reliability and facilitate future interventions.
    • Contribute to implementing tools and methods for the structured monitoring of our installed systems.

Requirements

Education & experience

  • Associate's, Bachelor's or Master's degree in instrumentation, applied physics, optoelectronics or a related technical field.
  • The position is open to both experienced technicians and engineers with a strong interest in hands-on, operational activities.
  • Previous experience in operations, system integration, maintenance or technical support for complex systems is preferred.
  • Experience working in a multidisciplinary hardware/software environment is highly valued.
  • Experience supporting or maintaining technical equipment installed at customer sites would be an advantage.

Technical skills Required

  • Good understanding of complex technical systems combining hardware and software.
  • Knowledge of electronics, instrumentation and/or control systems.
  • Ability to analyse operational data and characterise technical issues.
  • Ability to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations according to established procedures.
  • Ability to identify and involve the appropriate technical experts when required.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to rigorously track interventions, deadlines and outstanding actions.
  • Ability to follow, write and improve technical procedures.
  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, as you will interact directly with international customers and colleagues, deliver training sessions and produce technical documentation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of optics, photonics and/or cryogenics.
  • Hands-on experience with optical systems, including basic optical alignment.
  • Experience operating or maintaining cryogenic systems.
  • Basic programming or scripting skills, particularly Python.
  • Experience maintaining scientific or industrial equipment.
  • Experience delivering technical training to users or operators.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

We're looking for a Legal Counsel, AdTech Transactions to join our Legal team. This position sits at the intersection of ad tech, commercial contracting, and data and privacy law, in a market where platform policies, ATT, GDPR, and consent frameworks change several times a year. Your work will directly shape how Voodoo monetizes its inventory, buys and measures user acquisition, grows its advertising network, and handles player data,while keeping us within legal and platform requirements and player expectations.

Your main responsibilities :

  • Own ad tech transactions end-to-end for Voodoo's games and apps portfolio: draft, negotiate and close agreements with mediation platforms, ad networks, exchanges and SSPs on the sell side, and with ad networks, DSPs, direct advertisers and rewarded platforms on the buy side,including the incentive and rebate agreements (bonuses, UA credits, payment terms), that drive the commercial terms..

  • Negotiate agreements with mobile measurement partners, attribution and analytics vendors, data providers and other partners

  • Advise on SDK integrations and data flows together with the Privacy team, so contracts match what the tech actually does

  • Build our advertising network's contract framework and advertising policies for third-party publishers, advertisers and programmatic partners; negotiate its infrastructure agreements and structure its commercial offers on the legal side

  • Manage partner disputes with networks, mediation platforms and other ad tech partners, including reporting discrepancies, invalid traffic (IVT) and compensation claims, from first analysis through negotiated resolution.

  • Track and apply platform policy changes and translate them into contract positions and business guidance

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Monetization, UA, Ad Network, Publishing and other product teams, serving as a trusted legal partner who helps the business move with speed and confidence

Profile

  • 5-7 years of relevant legal experience, with meaningful time spent on ad tech and mobile/programmatic advertising, ideally in-house

  • Autonomy and initiative: you take ownership of your portfolio, identify problems before they escalate, and propose solutions rather than waiting to be directed

  • Master 2 in business law, IT/digital law or IP law from a French university or equivalent; avocat or in-house juriste profiles are equally welcome; an LL.M. or study abroad experience is a plus

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey... Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against. Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month. Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here . What have we been up to since then...? In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had: 🚀 Raised an awesome Series B investment round 🚀 Grown the team to over 70 Lakanauts, based across the UK, NL and France, enabling a choice-based, hybrid way of working 🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places! 🚀 Captured the UK, NL and French enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering 🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳) 🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like 🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out! Help us continue to change an outdated industry... We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company. 🤘🏼 The role Customer Experience (CX) at Laka CX are firmly at the heart of why Laka was created - we exist to be there for people when shit happens - our CX function is where this magic takes place... You'll be a key part of our Customer Experience team. Providing a great customer experience is the most important part of our plans to grow the Laka brand internationally. As part of a small, dedicated function (we currently have a team of 11 superstars), you'll be the first point of contact for general and claim-related enquiries. What you'll be getting up to: Supporting Laka customers (& potential customers) with general questions about Laka's products & services, their bicycle insurance and new initiatives via web chat and email Help Laka members to file their claims and guide them through the process of replacing or repairing their bikes and kit either directly with us or by coordinating with third-parties (shops, manufacturers, distributors etc) Be the first point of contact for our B2B partners, supporting them to get their riders back on the road Work closely with the CX team across both the UK and NL to provide a convenient, swift and seamless experience to our members Collate feedback from the collective on an ongoing basis and produce actionable intel to support decision making, both in the CX team and others around Laka Get stuck into our squad-based work, with the goal to continue to make Laka the best it can be (you might find yourself working on exciting projects with the Marketing, Product or Technology teams) Requirements 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you: We require that you speak English and German Have a super strong empathy for cyclists and what it means when someone has their bike nicked, damaged or injures themselves whilst out & about on their bike Have a decent understanding of technical terms in cycling (we can bring you up to speed with the latest bike tech), so you can best support all types of customers with whatever query is thrown your way Get loads of satisfaction from helping people going through a rough patch (losing your bike isn't easy, you know) - you'll understand what it means to go the extra mile and make a member's day Enjoy learning new things, working with a lovely bunch of people, and ultimately playing a huge part in the future of Laka! Are a fast learner and can get up to speed with common tools - we use a number of systems at Laka, but don't worry, we'll give you all the training you need Are comfortable chatting with our members, with excellent written communication in (native) German & English You might have already guessed it but it makes a lot of sense to be passionate about cycling when joining Laka. Don't worry about any insurance knowledge - we can teach you the ins-and-outs of insurance and support your knowledge on all things bike parts, too. We can work together on completing your skill set. Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised an awesome Series B investment round

🚀 Grown the team to over 70 Lakanauts, based across the UK, NL and France, enabling a choice-based, hybrid way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK, NL and French enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🤘🏼 The role

Customer Experience (CX) at Laka

CX are firmly at the heart of why Laka was created - we exist to be there for people when shit happens - our CX function is where this magic takes place...

You'll be a key part of our Customer Experience team. Providing a great customer experience is the most important part of our plans to grow the Laka brand internationally. As part of a small, dedicated function (we currently have a team of 11 superstars), you'll be the first point of contact for general and claim-related enquiries.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Supporting Laka customers (& potential customers) with general questions about Laka's products & services, their bicycle insurance and new initiatives via web chat and email
  • Help Laka members to file their claims and guide them through the process of replacing or repairing their bikes and kit either directly with us or by coordinating with third-parties (shops, manufacturers, distributors etc)
  • Be the first point of contact for our B2B partners, supporting them to get their riders back on the road
  • Work closely with the CX team across both the UK and NL to provide a convenient, swift and seamless experience to our members
  • Collate feedback from the collective on an ongoing basis and produce actionable intel to support decision making, both in the CX team and others around Laka
  • Get stuck into our squad-based work, with the goal to continue to make Laka the best it can be (you might find yourself working on exciting projects with the Marketing, Product or Technology teams)

Requirements

👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:

  • We require that you speak English and German
  • Have a super strong empathy for cyclists and what it means when someone has their bike nicked, damaged or injures themselves whilst out & about on their bike
  • Have a decent understanding of technical terms in cycling (we can bring you up to speed with the latest bike tech), so you can best support all types of customers with whatever query is thrown your way
  • Get loads of satisfaction from helping people going through a rough patch (losing your bike isn't easy, you know) - you'll understand what it means to go the extra mile and make a member's day
  • Enjoy learning new things, working with a lovely bunch of people, and ultimately playing a huge part in the future of Laka!
  • Are a fast learner and can get up to speed with common tools - we use a number of systems at Laka, but don't worry, we'll give you all the training you need
  • Are comfortable chatting with our members, with excellent written communication in (native) German & English

You might have already guessed it but it makes a lot of sense to be passionate about cycling when joining Laka. Don't worry about any insurance knowledge - we can teach you the ins-and-outs of insurance and support your knowledge on all things bike parts, too. We can work together on completing your skill set.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

What can you expect from working at Laka?

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London & Bristol (we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Company bonus scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions

We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description: About Nabla Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes: Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes. AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems. Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks. Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems. About the Role We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer . Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client? You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them. This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec , but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them. If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you. Responsibilities Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design. Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do. Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster. Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress. Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty. Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path. Qualifications 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus. Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code. Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python. Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard. Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet. Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT. Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written). Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry. Life at Nabla When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed. We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off . We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked. If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application. Our Values at Nabla Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion. Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link . Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them.

If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design.

  • Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do.

  • Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster.

  • Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress.

  • Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty.

  • Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path.

Qualifications

  • 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus.

  • Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code.

  • Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python.

  • Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard.

  • Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet.

  • Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT.

  • Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written).

Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry.

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

💡 As a Business Development Representative, you will play a key role in Flinn’s go-to-market success by building and qualifying a strong pipeline of high-quality opportunities. You will work at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Events, identifying the right prospects, starting meaningful conversations, and setting up the Sales team for successful first meetings. In this role, you will combine structured prospecting with curiosity, persistence, and strong communication skills to engage senior stakeholders at complex B2B organizations. Fluency in French is required (and in Spanish is preferred), as you will actively engage prospects across these markets. The role is based in Paris, France and includes regular collaboration with the broader go-to-market team as well as travel for conferences and customer meetings.

Why Flinn?

  • We are building a truly exceptional culture: While many companies claim to have a great culture, we invite you to discover what truly sets ours apart. Visit our career page, speak with our team, listen to our founders’ podcast, or experience our culture first-hand during the interview process.

  • Make a Meaningful Impact: Your work at Flinn contributes directly to solutions that improve people’s health and lives by making high-quality health products accessible for everyone.

  • Experienced, well-funded, highly professional: As well-funded startup veterans, we know how to sustain long-term business health and success, ensuring an environment for continuous personal growth.

What’s in it for you?

  • Join a fast-growing, well-funded European startup backed by experienced founders and investors.

  • Be part of a mission-driven health-tech company whose work directly improves people’s lives.

  • Play a key role in scaling Flinn’s GTM, shaping how we grow.

  • Work in a high-trust, low-ego environment with autonomy and clear ownership.

  • Work in a net-zero company where all unavoidable CO₂ emissions are compensated with carefully selected, high-quality removal certificates.

  • Receive one of the most employee-friendly equity packages, including fair vesting terms and profit-sharing opportunities.

  • Grow in a professional, high-standard environment that supports long-term personal and career development.

Your contributions to our journey:

  • Contribute to a strong prospecting strategy: identify and prioritize high-potential businesses across your region that are an ideal fit for Flinn.

  • Build a healthy pipeline: generate new opportunities through targeted outreach, discovery, and account research.

  • Qualify and book introductory meetings: set high-quality first conversations for the Sales team with the right stakeholders.

  • Nurture early-stage opportunities: maintain momentum with emerging leads to develop future pipeline.

  • Collaborate with Marketing & Events: convert conferences, webinars, and field activities into qualified opportunities and measurable pipeline.

What you need to be successful:

  • Strong communication, storytelling, and relationship-building skills with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders.

  • Highly energetic: being a self-starter is an absolute must.

  • Fluent in French, and English (written and spoken); fluency Spanish is a plus.

  • Persistent and driven: you thrive on overcoming objections and turning them into positive outcomes

  • Adaptability is key: you’re constantly trying new approaches, new tools, see what works, and what doesn’t

  • Willingness to travel for business meetings, conferences, and company events.

Attributes we are looking for:

  • 1+ year of experience in a commercial role, ideally as a BDR (or adjacent).

  • Proven experience running outbound sales motions (prospecting, outreach, qualification, and meeting-setting).

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and/or experience—comfortable taking ownership and operating in ambiguity.

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with strong problem-solving skills and excellent follow-through.

  • Committed to high-quality execution and consistently meeting deadlines.

🇪🇺 At this stage of our company, we can only accept applications from people who are based in Europe with either European citizenship, an active working visa or being self-employed and joining us as a full-time contractor (Except for US-based roles).

We strive to remove barriers, eliminate discrimination, and ensure equal opportunity through our transparent recruitment process. We are open to all groups of people without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer, GPU performance, you will sit at the heart of that spectrum: your low-level work directly determines how fast our frontier models can be trained and served. Working hand-in-hand with Research Scientists, you'll make every GPU count.

Mistral AI is hiring an expert in pushing large language model's GPU utilization and performance to their limits.. In this role, you will own the performance of our models end-to-end: writing the low-level code that extracts the maximum capacity from high-end hardware, and rethinking model architectures so they run efficiently at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Develop low-level code that takes full advantage of high-end GPUs and maxes out their capacity — from custom kernels to memory-layout and communication optimisations.

  • Rethink parts of the generative model architecture to make them more suitable for efficient inference, in collaboration with Research Scientists.

  • Integrate low-level efficient code into a high-level MLOps framework, so that optimisations benefit every training run and deployment rather than a single experiment.

  • Profile, benchmark and squeeze performance out of large-scale training and inference on thousands of GPUs.

  • Model LLM execution on various GPUs with high fidelity to assess hardware usage and build serving performance estimates.

What We're Looking For

  • High technical competence for writing custom low-level kernels and pushing GPUs to their limits.

  • High expertise in the distributed computation infrastructure of current-generation GPU clusters.

  • Overall understanding of the field of generative AI; knowledge of, or interest in, fine-tuning and using language models for applications.

  • Strong software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD.

  • Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative.

raw.title: Dessinateur Projeteur CAO
raw.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Au sein de l'équipe technique, vous concevez en CAO les pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques de nos produits, dans nos drones et leurs équipements embarqués. Votre quotidien est la modélisation sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks : mécanismes et pièces imprimés en 3D, intégration des composants électroniques, assemblages complets.

Vous faites évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des impressions et des essais, et vous produisez les plans, nomenclatures et documents de montage des versions validées.

Missions principales

Conception CAO (cœur de métier : 70 %)

  • Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks des pièces et sous-ensembles : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces

  • Concevoir des mécanismes imprimés en 3D : charnières, verrouillages, clips, pièces mobiles

  • Intégrer les composants électroniques dans la CAO : implantation des cartes, moteurs, ESC, batteries et capteurs, passage des câbles, refroidissement, accessibilité pour la maintenance

  • Appliquer les règles de conception FDM et autres procédés : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

  • Structurer les assemblages (paramétrage, composants réutilisables) pour faciliter les évolutions

  • Assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

  • Réaliser des conceptions paramétriques et modifiables

Prototypage rapide (15 %)

  • Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction

  • Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes

  • Faire évoluer les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais

Plans et documentation de production (10 %)

  • Réaliser les mises en plan et les nomenclatures des pièces et sous-ensembles validés

  • Participer à la rédaction des gammes de montage et des instructions d'assemblage

  • Participer aux modifications des schémas de câblage

Essais (5 %)

  • Participer aux essais de validation : banc, sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

  • Présenter régulièrement l'avancement à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché

Formation et expérience

  • Bac+2/+3 (BTS CPRP ou CPI, BUT GMP, licence pro) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique ou mécatronique

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion et SolidWorks (CATIA ou d'autres)

  • Conception de mécanismes et d'assemblages

  • Règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; pratique d'OrcaSlicer ou d'un autre slicer

  • Mise en plan, cotation et tolérancement

  • Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, câblage, soudure

Atouts

  • Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4)

  • Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices)

  • Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D (portfolio CAO apprécié)

  • Intérêt pour l'aéronautique, le spatial ou la défense

Qualités personnelles

  • Goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on » et la CAO "bien faite"

  • Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique

  • Autonomie, force de proposition et esprit d'équipe

raw.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Type de contrat : stage de 6 mois

Objet du poste

Au sein de l'équipe technique, vous participez à la conception et à la réalisation de nos prototypes, principalement des drones et leurs équipements embarqués. Votre mission est majoritairement axée sur la conception mécanique en CAO, avec une fabrication des pièces essentiellement en impression 3D. Ponctuellement, vous intervenez sur l'intégration et le dimensionnement de l'électronique embarquée afin de valider les prototypes de bout en bout, de la modélisation aux premiers essais. Vous contribuez ensuite à la mise en production des produits validés (DFM, optimisations, gammes de montage, schémas de câblage).

Missions principales

Conception CAO (cœur de mission : 55%)

  • Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 des pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces de charges utiles, …

  • Intégrer dès la conception les contraintes de la fabrication additive FDM : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

  • Faire évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais (cycles d'itération courts)

  • Réaliser les assemblages, et assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

Prototypage rapide (5%)

Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction pour valider rapidement les choix techniques

  • Analyser les résultats d'essais et les retours terrain afin d'orienter les itérations suivantes

  • Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes dans un objectif d’amélioration continue

Industrialisation et mise en production (30%)

  • Faire évoluer les prototypes validés vers une version industrialisable en appliquant les principes DFM / DFA (conception pour la fabrication et l'assemblage)

  • Optimiser les pièces et sous-ensembles : masse, coût, nombre de pièces, temps de fabrication, choix des procédés et matériaux de série

  • Participer à la rédaction les gammes de montage et les instructions d'assemblage

  • Réaliser les schémas de câblage et la documentation électrique associée

  • Constituer le dossier de définition du produit : plans, nomenclatures, tolérances

Intégration et dimensionnement électronique (5%)

  • Participer au choix et au dimensionnement des composants embarqués (motorisation, ESC, batteries, contrôleur de vol, capteurs, câblage) selon les contraintes du prototype : masse, encombrement, consommation, thermique

  • Prévoir dans la CAO l'implantation des cartes et composants, le passage des câbles, le refroidissement et l'accessibilité pour la maintenance

  • Assembler, câbler et réaliser les premiers tests d'intégration pour valider le fonctionnement des prototypes

  • Configurer et paramétrer les systèmes via Mission Planner (calibrations, paramètres, check avant vols)

Essais et documentation (5%)

  • Participer aux essais de validation : tests au banc, tests au sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

  • Documenter les conceptions, les choix techniques et les résultats d'essais

  • Présenter régulièrement l'avancement de ses travaux à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché

Formation

  • Étudiant(e) de niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs, licence professionnelle, master) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique, mécatronique ou équivalent

  • Stage (idéalement de fin d'études)

Compétences techniques

  • Très bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion

  • Connaissance des règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; la pratique d'OrcaSlicer (ou d'un autre slicer) est appréciée

  • Notions de résistance des matériaux, de tolérancement et de choix des matériaux (PLA, PETG, ASA, nylon, composites chargés)

  • Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, alimentation et puissance, dimensionnement de composants, soudure et câblage

Atouts

  • Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4) est un gros plus

  • Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices) est un plus

  • Profil mécatronique, capable de faire le lien entre mécanique, électronique et logiciel

  • Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D

  • Un intérêt pour les environnements aéronautique, spatial ou défense est apprécié

Qualités personnelles

  • Curiosité et goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on »

  • Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique

  • Autonomie, force de proposition et capacité à travailler en équipe

raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Labs Financial Services squad, based in Paris. The team is structured as a cross-functional Squad composed of a Senior Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, Software Engineers  and a QA engineer. You'll be mentored by Wael Osmani, Software Engineer. You'll join a team that builds and ships the core product features powering some of the world's most ambitious marketplace platforms, with a particular focus on financial services capabilities.


2. Your Impact

  • Contribute to the development and evolution of a production application, primarily on the frontend — from UI implementation to user experience improvements
  • Support backend work by participating in API design and development, collaborating closely with the engineering team
  • Work hand-in-hand with UX/UI designers to deliver features that are both technically solid and user-centric
  • Take part in agile rituals — stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives — and contribute actively to the team's roadmap
  • Monitor and take ownership of your contributions in production, following a you build it, you run it mindset


3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • Currently pursuing a Master's degree (M1 or M2) in software engineering, computer science, or a related field, and looking for a 6-month internship
  • First hands-on development experience through an internship, academic project, apprenticeship, or personal project
  • Solid understanding of frontend development and object-oriented programming principles
Skills:
  • Proficiency or strong interest in frontend frameworks such as React or Angular, and in JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Familiarity with Java for backend and API development
  • Curiosity for clean code, software quality, and working on production-grade applications
  • A collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine drive to learn


4. Tech Stack

  • Back-end: Java 21, Spring Boot
  • Front-end: ReactJS
  • Data & Messaging: Kafka, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL
  • Tooling & Practices: CI/CD, Git, Docker, Monitoring


5. Languages

  • French: Fluent
  • English: Professional proficiency (written and spoken)

 

Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  • Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.

  3. Hiring Manager interview (45 min) — technical discussion covering Java and web development fundamentals, including practical exercises
  4. STAR interview (1h) — exchange with one or two team members exploring Mirakl's values and culture

title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
description: We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights .   About CXG: Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide. The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation. We are passionate about delivering impact. Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction. We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality. Context and role Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals. This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member. Thought Leadership Development Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar. Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions. Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to: Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects. Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap. Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation. Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence. Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality. Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets. Thought Leadership Communication Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis. Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market. Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap. Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content. Develop the content and key messages for CXG-hosted events and external conferences, panels and talks; act as a CXG speaker where appropriate; and work with internal experts to prepare other CXG speakers and turn the company's point of view into compelling presentations and discussion topics. Look for and test new thought leadership formats (e.g., interactive reports, data visualisations, short-form video, newsletters, social-first content) to broaden reach, engage new audiences and keep CXG's content distinctive. Identify and build collaborations with conferences, specialised industry magazines and universities (e.g., content partnerships, guest articles, co-branded publications, joint research, guest lectures, speaking slots) to extend CXG's visibility and credibility with target audiences. Market Intelligence Keep abreast of market and competitive developments and ensure relevant findings are communicated across CXG. Translate these findings into clear implications for CXG's strategic priorities, client conversations, commercial opportunities and external thought leadership. Contribute market intelligence, evidence and relevant CXG perspectives to priority proposals and client deliverables, working with Practices, Solutions and Regions to strengthen the quality and relevance of the final output. Manage and develop the Market Intelligence team member, setting clear priorities and reviewing the quality and usefulness of their work. Competitive Analysis Develop and continuously update a list of CXG competitors. Research competitor performance, including revenues and market share where reliable information is available. Identify and assess the impact of new competitors' offerings. Review competitors' thought leadership, influence and presence. Identify gaps in the conversations competitors are leading and opportunities for CXG to establish a distinct position. Industry Analysis Research and review clients' developments (e.g., new strategy, launch of new product or service, restructuring, M&A, key managerial appointments). Track public financial announcements (e.g., quarterly and annual earnings). Monitor developments in luxury, retail, customer experience and adjacent sectors; distinguish lasting shifts from short-lived topics and explain their implications for CXG and its clients. Publish the weekly "This Week in Luxury" news brief and issue timely flash updates when significant developments require immediate attention, such as financial announcements, major transactions or leadership changes. Internal Dissemination and Application Synthesise research and findings into concise, actionable outputs tailored to the needs of relevant internal stakeholders. Feed findings into the Thought Leadership roadmap. Proactively bring relevant market signals to Practices, Regions and leadership early enough to inform decisions, client conversations and potential cross-practice opportunities. Disseminate new thought leadership across CXG and equip Practices, Regions and client-facing teams with the key messages and supporting materials needed to use it in client conversations and commercial activities. Requirements What will you bring along? Proven experience developing thought leadership, editorial content or insight-led communications in a consulting, research, customer experience, retail or luxury environment. Excellent English writing and editing skills, with a portfolio demonstrating original, well-argued, evidence-led articles or publications written personally. If possible, include examples that turn proprietary research, data or specialist expertise into a distinctive point of view. Additional languages (e.g., French, Mandarin) are a plus. Strong oral communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to represent CXG as a speaker at conferences, panels and client events. Proven ability to build relationships and influence senior stakeholders across functions and regions without direct authority. An established network or demonstrated ability to build partnerships with media, conference organisers, academic institutions or industry bodies. Comfort working with quantitative data and research methods, and the ability to translate data into clear, credible narratives and visualisations. Ability to define and track content performance indicators and use them to refine editorial priorities. Strong research and analytical skills: able to assess sources critically, connect market signals and form a clear point of view rather than simply summarise trends. Familiarity with AI-assisted research and content tools, used with appropriate rigour. Sound knowledge of luxury, retail and customer experience, and curiosity about how these sectors are evolving across markets. Ability to interview senior experts, challenge ideas constructively and turn specialist knowledge into accessible, credible content. Comfort working independently in a remote setting, managing an editorial roadmap and delivering finished work without a large production team. Experience managing or coaching at least one team member. Confidence preparing and hosting interviews or podcasts is a plus. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
